The decisive mistake was made at Step 1. PublicationData_Expert used the assumed 1000 articles, which the manager offered only as a fallback, instead of finding the actual number of Nature research articles in 2020 (about 1002). It also applied a 5% false positive rate rather than the average p-value of 0.04. With 1002 articles and a 0.04 rate, the result is 40.08, which rounds up to 41. The 1000-article demonstration value gave 50, which was wrong. VerificationExpert then accepted this without checking, but the error originated in Step 1.
